_comment: Event schema for the (not-yet-live) GolfRaven GTM/GA4 container
(build plan §5.1 BaseLayout.astro: 'A new GolfRaven GTM/GA4 container
(O13 DECIDED 2026-09-23: RavenPower's is not reused)'; §10 P2 stage-2
scope item 6: 'Keep the GTM slot empty. The container ID comes from
build config later (O13).').
THIS FILE AND src/components/Analytics.astro MUST AGREE — same
contract SWC's own analytics-schema.json/Analytics.astro pair used:
Analytics.astro decides what the site is allowed to PUBLISH to
dataLayer; this file is what GTM would be configured to READ once the
container exists. A key here the site never pushes is simply empty in
GA4; a key the site pushes that is missing here never reaches GA4 at
all. Neither failure leaks anything, but both are silent — change them
together, and see test/analytics-pii.test.ts (the ported
test-analytics-pii.mjs harness) for the enforcement.
`booking_click` (§6.1 T0 row): 'A first-party booking_click event (no
PII) builds the T1 case [for a GolfNow partner-API application].'
`provider`/`trail_slug` are public catalog identifiers, never a
visitor's own data.
NEVER add name, email, message, phone or a free-text field for any
facility/trail label. The claim/feedback form's eventual submission
(stage 3, the Worker backend) already carries all of that out of band.
